authorization: User authorized starting hierarchical skeleton generation and clarified that the primary product is a generated skeleton-token sequence reusable across poses/motions. Per-mesh localization supplies supervision and deployment, not the research objective. Existing trained weights are only a temporary initialization for bounded method-feasibility tests. Keep dynamic-frame evidence, unknown variable-length skeleton generation, and all joint identities. Do not launch formal full retraining before method validation.

baseline.scope: Historical checkpoint-matched manifests only for this feasibility probe; not a change to the current production dataset. Preserve the source checkpoint and all prior outputs.

features.cache_boundary: Independent per-frame surface tokens and raw source point tracks, BEFORE any motion encoder or evidence aggregation. Source features preserve the existing common-query chart. Target features use each mesh's own reversible mesh-only chart and never pass through source temporal encoding. Recompute source temporal features and u/O/M evidence after selecting the actual T input frames. Never subsample full-clip contextualized features.
features.original_motion_evidence: Preserve bias_h8 and all u/c/d channels. No relation residual or skeleton/GT-derived conditioning.

data.selection: Seeded source/joint-count-band round-robin, reusing the audited first 8 training and 16 validation asset IDs, with a new explicit 32-frame pool. First 24 pool slots are eligible motion evidence; final 8 are excluded from structure generation and reserved for sequence reuse. Dynamic T=2..24 selects evidence slots only. Supervise all selected evidence frames plus the 8 reuse frames, retaining every joint. Fixed pools are a feasibility fixture; fresh poses/actions are required for formal validation.
data.targets: Complete posed GT with fixed per-asset identity and parent order. The unchanged base loader supplies common-query coordinates for source evidence. Localization applies a separate per-target-mesh bounding-box affine with fixed 1.1 padding to both mesh and GT, with an exact source-space inverse. No GT-derived bounds, clipping, filtering, new roots, or tail targets. Removing auxiliary root/RT nodes in v3 does not undo global coordinate motion.
data.quantization: Keep [-1,1]/256 on the target mesh's own padded chart. Mesh-only 1.1 padding covers the audited 48 assets/24 selected frames, whose unpadded local targets span [-1.0053182,1.0139827]. Check every new selected target strictly, including the new 32-frame pool. No clipping or GT-dependent normalization. This does not certify full-dataset coverage or preserve old common-query physical grid spacing.

preflight.acceptance: Exact full-joint identity, reversible mesh-only target charts and source/data hashes; raw-versus-cached geometry parity; masked tree roundtrip; teacher-forcing/manual-prefix consistency; reusable sequence serialization/rebinding with no source encoder or AR rerun; finite all-frame losses/gradients and new-module/backbone updates; XYZ-only gradients reach the structure generator; frozen features unchanged; T24/J512 with 32 target frames fits 90% GPU memory. Natural EOS and max-length failure remain distinct. Execution acceptance only, not quality approval.

probe.loss: Per-asset mean structure CE plus per-asset XYZ CE averaged over all valid target frames/joints/axes; average actual assets across accumulation. Target frames are the selected evidence frames plus 8 excluded reuse frames. Structure is supervised once per asset. XYZ losses backpropagate through the shared skeleton sequence. No coordinate equality or blanket latent-vector equality loss.
probe.acceptance: Primary endpoint is a usable generated reusable skeleton sequence, not only teacher-forced pose reconstruction. Compare initialized/trained identical inputs; separate GT-prefix from natural free generation; report EOS, joint count, parents and identity-preserving geometry on excluded target frames. Save generated sequences and rebind without regeneration. Compare sequences from different evidence subsets on the same excluded meshes, and test input/memory dependence. Different subsets of one recorded action are only a reuse proxy, not proof across distinct actions. No automatic full retraining or promotion.
